findings.consequence: The delta_v sensitivity is understated by about a factor 2 (about -16 to -17% at delta_v=-0.8, not about -9%). findings.evidence: Analytic derivation (audit Sec. 4.2); direct lattice construction with exact mean density (dv_check.py, antithetic pair) reproduces the mass-consistent formula to every printed digit and not the [1G-E] one (f_v=0.737, delta_v=-0.8: measured 1.0896, [1G-E] formula 1.1412, mass-consistent 1.0896). Recomputed at a=15, compressed: delta_v=-0.9: 1.435 [GM] / 1.249 [NW15] (reported 1.493 / 1.297); delta_v=-0.8: 1.298 / 1.142 (reported 1.418 / 1.242). Range lower edges: 0.820 [GM] (reported 0.93), 0.795 [NW15] (reported 0.89). Alternative closure (void matter carries the same delta_w): 1.321 / 1.164 at delta_v=-0.8, also below the report.
findings.statement: With uniform void interiors (1+delta_v)<rho> and walls carrying the remaining mass with the fractional field delta_w, mass conservation gives 1+delta_W = (f_w - f_v delta_v)/f_w, hence delta = -delta_v(chi_w/f_w - 1) + (f_w - f_v delta_v)(chi_w/f_w) delta_w and sigma^2 = delta_v^2 sigma_part^2 + (f_w - f_v delta_v)^2 sigma_int^2. [1G-E] keeps sigma_int unchanged, which requires walls at <rho>/f_w while voids also hold mass (mean density [1 + f_v(1+delta_v)]<rho>). The partition amplitude delta_v^2 is correct; the internal term is not.
findings.suggested_resolution: Owner decision: adopt sigma^2 = delta_v^2 sigma_part^2 + (f_w - f_v delta_v)^2 sigma_int^2 and update the delta_v table, the '-9%' statement, the ranges and the inventory; or restrict the formula and tables to delta_v = -1. Record the choice in a dated successor note and in the token's recorded meaning.
findings.title: The non-empty-void formula sigma^2 = delta_v^2 sigma_part^2 + sigma_int^2 violates mass conservation

findings.statement: [1G-E] lines 86-87: '`s = 1` (no compression) is the upper bracket. Real walls are sheets and filaments, so their compression is anisotropic.' This implies that anisotropy moves the value from the isotropic primary toward s = 1. Under E3 (pair orientation independent of wall orientation), volume-f_w anisotropic maps give sigma_int below the isotropic primary. method.independence: No phase script or package import in the recomputation; no other auditor's output read.
method.monte_carlo: Lattice method: exact distance test at every node of a 320^3 lattice in a 16a periodic box, exact FFT autocorrelation, ball variance over all lattice positions against the analytic lattice-ball value; 24 independent realisations per parameter set (master seeds 101, 202). Phase MC rerun with seeds 1-15 for comparison.
method.recomputation: Tracker closed forms from [GM] main.tex line 663; EH98 no-wiggle from trans.tex lines 683, 759, 778-779, 839-842; LCDM growth by direct quadrature (0.7878126); sigma_part by quad with a break point at 2a and by Gauss-Legendre; sigma_int by a real-space route sigma_L^2(R/s) + int P_R xi_w xi_L(r/s) dr with xi_L by QAWF (validated against k-space sigma_L^2 to <= 2e-5).
method.sensitivities: [W09]-consistent two-population Boolean voids; anisotropic E4 maps (sheets, filaments, void shells); equal-mass radius convention; direct lattice check of the delta_v algebra.
